name: Lerthai Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1979, Lerthai Finance Ltd is in the business of financing and investment[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company was formerly known as Marathwada Refractories Ltd and was engaged in production, manufacture and trading of refractories and bricks. Company amended its object clause in the Memorandum of association in FY19 and discontinued its business activities as they were not resulting in a profitable venture. At present, company is in the business activity of financing and investment and is looking our for viable business opportunities

cons: Stock is trading at 3.53 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 4.94% over last 3 years.
